title: The fix-branch deny lets a conflicted merge of main through, so it can get its one more fix verifier
why: The owner ruled (2026-11-10 14:07 CST, decision pr-review-record) that a conflicted merge of main after a PASS fix verifier takes one more fix verifier. The fix-branch deny refuses the push that verifier needs (merge.py --fix-check accepts only the live head), and its remedy says "new branch and new PR". A conflict with main on a fixed PR is normal lane work.
source: lane fix-branch-merge-main-deny, round-3 reviewer on PR #3102, 00:03 CST Nov 13
note: Settled by the owner ruling above, so no owner item: the "new-PR remedy stands" option departs from it. Allow a two-parent merge whose first parent is the newest record's Head and whose second parent is on origin/main (the shape merge.py accepts); the conflicted merge then owes one fix verifier. Red test first: that push is refused on main today. Keep refusing any other push after a fix check. Stacks on #3102 and #2979.
